gen-gf-revalia-gf-momo-trust-display: That open-bottomed g gives Revalia its wandering swagger. Momo Trust Display follows in plain sans, its drifting, generous letters leaving paragraphs lots of space to breathe.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mukta: Loud, loose and a little theatrical, Revalia spreads its wide-set letters under tall stalks, while Mukta keeps its small letters upright and tidy. Plain sans meets showpiece.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar reads friendly and compact, its ascenders trimmed short so lines sit snugly together. Revalia is the one to make a statement with its relaxed, widely spaced stride, and Mukta Malar is the one to hold the details.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-narnoor: Expressive from the first glance, Revalia lets its g swing open at the bottom and strides across wide gaps. Narnoor settles in beneath with short ascenders above big bowls, a sober sans that never competes.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-display: Revalia stretches out with a tall band of letters, short stalks above and a loose, unhurried stride. And Noto Sans Display answers with its big, tall middle zone, plain sans that gives the heading room to show off.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Revalia pairs low-slung, bowl-heavy heading letters with a g whose lower curve stays open. Sofia Sans Condensed brings a big x-height and tight ascender room, approachable sans-serif text that gives the heading the stage.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-viga: That open lower curve on the g is Revalia's signature, loose and bold at once. Viga stays hairline-free and shadow-free beneath it, plain sans with almost no stroke variation, so the heading carries all the flourish.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk reads lively but level-headed, with tall lowercase letters and bowls left slightly unfinished on one side. Shantell Sans is the showy one, its wide mouths shining when set large and brief.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-assistant: Shantell Sans has mouths as wide as a tin can's cut lid, drawn with one fixed nib width. Assistant counters with open, uncluttered shapes, and that steady clarity is the pair's best trait: playful on top, composed below.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-asta-sans: Asta Sans draws tubelike, constant-weight lines, with an e you would never mistake for a blot. And Shantell Sans adds its fixed-nib wobble on top, so paragraphs below stay crisp and approachable from start to finish.
